stageNotes: Stage 1: apex store.theshootingcentre.com returns 200 cleanly with Chrome120 UA; canonical = apex. robots.txt declares no Sitemap directive; BC default /xmlsitemap.php used.

Stage 2: Cloudflare passive (cf-ray, __cf_bm, cf-cache-status:DYNAMIC; all 4 production UAs 200 on /firearms/?page=2). No CAPTCHA, no age-gate markers in 425KB homepage. Heavy probe skipped (IP-ban safety).

Stage 3: platform=bigcommerce-stencil (x-bc-store-id:1000882963, BC-Ray, cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-stx5s5fhga, stencil/ paths, x-makeswift). adapterType=generic-retail (DB-confirmed intentional mapping). needsPlaywright=false (plain HTTP returns full product HTML).

Stage 4: 8 top-level categories from /xmlsitemap.php?type=categories (203 total cats, 8 single-segment). Each top-level renders products with multi-page pagers; parents aggregate subtree. Extraction spot-check (3 products) all pass title/price/stock.
Stage 5: pagination ?page=N (query form). page1 vs page2 on /firearms/ = 20 vs 20 ids, 0 overlap. perPage probed: ?limit=100 honored (100 products rendered).

Stage 6: sortParam=?sort=newest, sortVerified=true via 3-outcome counter-control with cache-bust. newest first-5 ids 32782/32781/32780/32778/32769 (monotonic desc); default(alphaasc) & counter(pricedesc) both differ.
Stage 7: navigate-from-watermark (sort honored + numeric monotonic product IDs as newest proxy). BC /products.json not used; HTML sort walk is the path.
Stage 8: expectedProductCount=17,305 via product sitemap (3 pages: 3132+9997+4176; 17,305 unique <loc>). DB 16,985 is ~1.9% low (catalog grew since 2026-04-08), not stale/wrong.
